- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Merchant is one of the NPCs in Terraria that offers a variety of items for sale useful for progressing through the game.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Merchant sells tools such as pickaxes and axes, weapons like swords, bows, and guns, armor sets, healing items like potions, explosives such as bombs and dynamite, accessories for stat increases, and light sources like torches.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The items the Merchant sells depend on the progression of the game and the player's level.
- [USER] User found a suspicious looking eye.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The suspicious looking eye is likely the Eye of Cthulhu, a boss that can be summoned using a Suspicious Looking Eye item.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Suspicious Looking Eye can be crafted using 6 Lens, which drop from the Demon Eye enemy or can be purchased from the Merchant NPC.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Eye of Cthulhu is the first boss that can be fought in the game and can be summoned at night.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Upon defeat, the Eye of Cthulhu drops loot such as coins and items for crafting new weapons and armor, and grants the "First Blood" achievement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Eye of Cthulhu is a challenging boss; players should be well-prepared with good equipment, weapons, and accessories before fighting it.
- [USER] User asked about the Spelunker potion.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Spelunker potion grants the "Spelunker" buff, highlighting all ores and treasure within the player's line of sight.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The Spelunker potion can be crafted using bottled water, a glowstick, and a fireblossom at an alchemy station.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The potion's duration is relatively short and does not reveal everything; it can be combined with other items for better results.
- [USER] User found a huge beehive.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] A huge beehive can be found in the Jungle biome and can be harvested for honey, which is used for crafting items like honeyed food and honeyed grog.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Harvesting a beehive releases aggressive bees, so players should be well-prepared before harvesting.
